canon: Cardo espinoso de tallo rígido y flor cerrada de un gris metálico apagado (con matiz violáceo: decisión de la usuaria, 2026-10-25), con una única fibra central imantada que, colgada de un hilo, siempre señala el mismo rumbo.

prompt.sujeto: A tall, rigid thistle of dark gunmetal silver, its thick stem twisted and covered in sharp metal thorns, with a few stiff blade-like leaves curling out from the base.
prompt.proporcion: Each plant stands about two metres tall, and its closed bud is about the size of a human head.
prompt.cuerpo: At the top sits a large closed bud like an artichoke forged from overlapping metal blades, dull metallic grey with a faint violet tint.
rasgos: From the tip of each bud a single long, thin, wiry filament arches up and bends in one direction, like an antenna.
prompt.rasgosSecundarios: Fine metallic burrs crowd the stem below each bud, and the thorns catch the light like tiny steel needles.
prompt.pose: In the middle ground, several of the thistles of different heights stand spread along a rocky slope, the nearest sharp and large, the farthest small and soft in the haze.
prompt.entorno: In the foreground, red gravel, broken stones and tufts of dry grass cover the ground among low plants with broad, woolly silver-green leaves. On the right a towering red sandstone cliff rises over the slope, and far to the left a wide red desert with flat-topped mesas fades into the haze on the horizon, under a wide sky stained with amber.
prompt.luz: Warm late-afternoon light falls through a thick amber haze, picking out the metallic sheen of the buds and thorns and casting long soft shadows across the gravel.

momento:atardecer.luz: Warm low evening light falls from behind with a gentle backlight, picking out the metallic sheen of the flower and the thorns and casting long soft shadows across the gravel.

momento:noche.luz: A soft, even pearly glow under the stars gently outlines the metallic sheen of the flower and the thorns, and deep cool shadows pool across the gravel.

propuestas: diseño de la imagen del juego (usuaria, 2026-10-26: «todo lo que hay ahora en las imágenes es lo que me gustaría igualar»); donde choca con el canon, va como propuesta de lore
choca con el canon: alto como un orco (antes, como una mano), acantilado rojo en vez del campo de rocas imantadas
IMG-16 (perfil fotorreal): dos metros de alto y yema del tamaño de una cabeza (antes «como un orco»), el paisaje por capas; diseño de imagen, no canon
